items.intent: Add private networking resources and adjust JavaScript model shape
transformationChain: TrafficController gains private endpoint connection and private link child resources. Across 2025-10-01-preview and 2026-03-01, the new contracts expose delete, get, list, and update for endpoint connections and get and list for links. Compatibility customizations also exclude JavaScript from selected property flattening without changing JSON.

findings.title: Generated SDK model property shape changes
findings.summary: JavaScript construction and member access can change from flattened properties to nested objects, breaking existing callers despite identical JSON serialization.
evidence: Changing flattenProperty to exclude JavaScript can change generated JavaScript construction and property access from flattened to nested.

documents.title: Adding a Stable Version when the Last Version was Preview
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Remove the replaced preview version from the version enum.
documents.applicableGuidance: The new operations bypass the documented PrivateEndpoints and PrivateLinks interfaces, the stable version retains its preview predecessor, and the change adds legacy flattening customizations despite greenfield guidance.
documents.evidence: The version change declares both v2025_10_01_preview and v2026_03_01.
documents.expectedCodeReason: The bounded official document evidence did not contain an example block.

documents.title: Private Endpoints
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Resource providers that support private endpoint connections must declare a private endpoint connection resource type and use the standard `PrivateEndpoints` interface to expose operations.
documents.applicableGuidance: The new operations bypass the documented PrivateEndpoints and PrivateLinks interfaces, the stable version retains its preview predecessor, and the change adds legacy flattening customizations despite greenfield guidance.
documents.evidence: The change adds PrivateEndpointConnection and a custom @armResourceOperations interface.

documents.title: Private Links
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Resource providers that support private link resources must declare a private link resource type and use the standard `PrivateLinks` interface to expose operations.
documents.applicableGuidance: The new operations bypass the documented PrivateEndpoints and PrivateLinks interfaces, the stable version retains its preview predecessor, and the change adds legacy flattening customizations despite greenfield guidance.
documents.evidence: The change adds PrivateLinkResource and a custom @armResourceOperations interface.

findings.title: Replaced preview remains in the version enum
findings.summary: The 2026-03-01 stable version is added while 2025-10-01-preview remains, contrary to stable-after-preview guidance.
evidence: The version change declares both v2025_10_01_preview and v2026_03_01.

findings.title: Private endpoint operations bypass the standard interface
findings.summary: PrivateEndpointConnectionsInterface is a custom ARM interface instead of using the documented PrivateEndpoints interface.
evidence: The change adds PrivateEndpointConnection and a custom @armResourceOperations interface.

findings.title: New code relies on legacy property flattening
